content.title: GIII Q3 Deep Dive: Owned Brands and Direct-to-Consumer Offset Wholesale Headwinds
content.summary: Fashion conglomerate G-III (NASDAQ:GIII) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 9% year on year to $988.6 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.98 billion at the midpoint came in 1.3% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.90 per share was 17.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
